svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm: two 1500 mm lengths of 50 x 50 x 5 angle, one each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the post, upright faces on the post, flat faces on top, outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 17 mm hole 200 mm from the back end, 20 mm up: M16 bolt

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through both angles and the post. Holes 13 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 25 mm up, at 100, 900 and 1348 mm: back pulley, brace, tip pulley.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Brace: two 990 mm lengths of 40 x 40 x 4 angle at 45 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M12 to the arm, M16 through the post with a 5 mm packing plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pulleys: 100 mm steel sheaves on M12 axles with spacer tubes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Winch: brake winch rated 270 kg, two U-bolts round the post, 1 m up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rope: 5 mm steel wire from the winch over both pulleys; hook with latch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with no load the hook hangs 1.2 m out from the post.
